Name: Dream SMP-Casino-Quackity Mr. Qi Replacer
Author: shyronic
Description:
[size=5]VERSION 2.0 IS HERE! COMPATIBLE WITH 1.6!
[/size]Hello everyone, long time no see! This mod has been updated for version 1.6 along with a few new details!
- Optional casino recolour (configurable in the config menu or with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config[/url]! Might cause conflicts, I tested it and it works fine? But you may have to disable it!)
- Tonnes of new dialogue depending on your friendship level!
- You can now gift and become friends with him!
- Special mini-event if you talk to him on his birthday!
[b]- I have not tested the endgame content, specifically with the walnut room. If you do test it, let me know how it goes! There is an optional config for the changes I did, by the way. You can disable those if it doesn't work.[/b]

(All data is optional, if you want just the portraits, you can toggle everything off except for the portraits in the mod menu to help ease conflicts.)

Please report any bugs you may find! This is my first time back into modding, so any bug reports are truly appreciated!

Translation in Portuguese coming soon, hopefully!
Tradução em português em breve!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Dgzzygw.gif[/img]

---

this mod replaces mr. qi with quackity's character on the dream smp (dubbed by fans as casino!quackity) just bc it fits lol

i made this for my own use, but my friends really wanted it too so im just posting it here

[b]**THIS REQUIRES CONTENT PATCHER TO WORK**[/b]

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
(if he contacts me and asks to take this down, i will, but i dont see the harm in this so it shouldnt be something to worry abt)
